conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.issue: Hydra uses YAML inheritance; JSONL is flat. How to represent 'extends from base config'?
conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.resolution: Add 'parent_id' field to JSONL config record; resolve at read time
conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.impact: MEDIUM - Need to normalize inheritance model

conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.issue: GitHub Actions YAML has complex conditionals (if: github.event.pull_request.draft == false). JSONL cannot natively represent code.
conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.resolution: Option A: Serialize conditionals as expression strings. Option B: Pre-evaluate conditionals and store results.
conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.impact: MEDIUM - Need expression language or AST representation

conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.issue: Capability tags are hierarchical (e.g., 'ci' → 'ci.healer' → 'ci.healer.auto-fix'). JSONL best suited to flat records.
conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.resolution: Option A: Flatten hierarchy into dot-notation tags. Option B: Create separate CapabilityTree schema.

conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.issue: Agent descriptions are Markdown; JSONL can store as text but loses formatting context.
conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.resolution: Store as markdown text in JSONL; use separate rendering step for UI

conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.issue: Agents reference other agents (handoff targets); creates cycles. JSONL is append-only; cycles require post-processing.
conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.example: Agent A hands off to Agent B; B can trigger A
conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.resolution: Store edges in separate RelationshipGraph JSONL; resolve references at query time
conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.impact: MEDIUM - Need separate schema for relationships

conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.issue: Some data cannot be easily represented in JSON (e.g., Pinecone embeddings as large arrays)
conflicts_with_target_jsonl_model.resolution: Store references/pointers in JSONL; data stored separately in vector DB

requires_transformation.action: REFACTOR: Extract schema; serialize conditionals as expressions
TRANSFORM: Flatten hierarchy; normalize to dot-notation

requires_new_schema.action: CREATE_NEW: Separate schema for directed edges
